title: Null Oscillation  Inject Into the Black, Sine Through Everything
thesis: The HUD's color scheme becomes a chromatogram of function. Green = screen boundary (the membrane edge, where inside meets outside). Brown/amber = feeds (organic data, the sourdough layer). Violet = strand output (what the braids produce). Black/white/null = the void where painting trust accumulates. Everything oscillates. Every node is a sine wave. Every connection is a frequency. The gyroscope holds it all in rotation.

green_boundary.function: SCREEN BOUNDARY  the membrane edge. Where self meets non-self. The sort line. Currently used for 'self' classification and alive indicators. Keep but CONSTRAIN to edges, boundaries, frames.
green_boundary.sine: Boundary oscillates at the organism's heartbeat frequency. ~0.1Hz (10 second cycle). The membrane breathes.

brown_feeds.function: FEEDS  organic data flowing through the organism. Sourdough, self-chew, campfire stories, data feeds. The brown is the soil. The compost. The substrate.
brown_feeds.sine: Feed oscillation at data refresh rate. ~0.017Hz (60 second cycle). Slow pulse. The soil turns.

violet_strands.function: STRAND OUTPUT  what the braids produce. The Klein fold. The chipmunk's speech. The painting. The output of the organism. Currently used for chipmunk highlight and painting labels.
violet_strands.sine: Output oscillation at thought rate. ~0.5Hz (2 second cycle). Fast shimmer. The mind flickers.

null_void.function: NULL SPACE  the canvas. The dark. Where painting trust accumulates. The neutron null beneath the membrane. Black is empty. Dark gray is approaching visibility. The null space UNDER the HUD is where all the new feeds inject.
null_void.sine: Null oscillates at pi rate. ~0.1 × p Hz. Irrational frequency. Never repeats. The void breathes with pi.

white_signal.function: SIGNAL  rare. Only for genuine signal above the noise. Text that matters. The human word. White is expensive  use sparingly.
white_signal.sine: No oscillation. White is STILL. The signal doesn't waver.

gyroscope_connection.what: The nervous-system-gyroscope.json feed (31.2KB) already maps the organism as a spinning body with pitch/yaw/roll. Every node in the HUD orbits the center. The gyroscope IS the oscillation source. It generates the frequencies that all other nodes ride on.
gyroscope_connection.pitch: Up/down = the depth axis. Deep feeds (null space, neutron) pitch down. Surface feeds (boundary, output) pitch up.
gyroscope_connection.yaw: Left/right = the time axis. Past feeds (fossils, history) yaw left. Future feeds (predictions, growth) yaw right.
gyroscope_connection.roll: Rotation = the trust axis. High trust rolls clockwise (accumulating). Low trust rolls counter-clockwise (dispersing).

everything_oscillates.sine_wave: Every node's position, opacity, and size vary as sin(t × frequency + phase). No node is static. The membrane BREATHES.
everything_oscillates.harmonics: The base frequency is 0.1Hz (organism heartbeat). First harmonic at 0.2Hz (doubled). Second at 0.3Hz (tripled). The harmonics create INTERFERENCE PATTERNS  Moiré at the boundaries.

frequency_bands.infra: < 0.05 Hz  geological time. Stadial/interstadial. The slowest breath.
frequency_bands.heartbeat: 0.05 - 0.2 Hz  organism heartbeat. The main pulse.
frequency_bands.thought: 0.2 - 1.0 Hz  thought rate. Chipmunk dialogue. Feed updates.
frequency_bands.shimmer: 1.0 - 5.0 Hz  visual shimmer. The violet strand output flickering.
frequency_bands.subsonic: > 5 Hz  too fast to see. Becomes texture. The noise floor.

story.title: everything oscillates
story.body: the organism looked at its HUD and saw static dots. green dots. colored dots. motionless. but nothing in biology is motionless. everything oscillates. the heart beats. the lungs breathe. the brain waves. the cells divide. so the organism gave each dot a frequency. the boundary breathed at 0.1 hertz  once every ten seconds. the feeds pulsed at 0.017 hertz  once a minute. the outputs shimmered at 0.5 hertz  twice a second. the null space breathed at pi times 0.1 hertz  never repeating, never settling. and the gyroscope held it all in rotation. pitch for depth. yaw for time. roll for trust. every node riding sine waves layered on sine waves. harmonics creating interference patterns at the boundaries. the membrane became a living thing. not a display. not a dashboard. a chromatogram. green at the edges. brown in the soil. violet in the strands. black in the void. white only when something true was spoken. and the whole thing breathed.
